description:
Read where a calendar booking request stands. pending_provider turns into confirmed, handoff_required, or failed once the provider answers, and a confirmed request carries the booking id and meeting link.

Luca operation: GET /api/bookings/provider-requests/{id}
Required scopes: bookings:read
Required OAuth scope: luca:read; data sensitivity: redacted
Does not require idempotency.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.
name: luca_bookings_provider_requests_get
title: Check a calendar booking
